text:
eva: Heads up — got 3 inbound requests that look like the same ask: 'per-tenant API rate limits' from ACME, BetaCorp, and partner ops. Can we canonicalize into one backlog item and decide owner?

sam: Links to the three threads: https://rwd.slack/threads/2042, https://rwd.slack/threads/2098, https://rwd.slack/threads/2101. They all mention throttling + admin control.

maria: ACME flagged this as blocking for launch of their integration. They indicated willingness to pay for SLA. Please mark customer:paid-high if we keep them as a stakeholder.

kevin: Quick engineering check — are customers asking for enforcement only, or enforcement + UI to configure? Those are different scopes. Also need to know whether auth is per-api-key or per-tenant-id.

eva: Good call. Proposed canonical summary for intake: "Per-tenant rate limits + quotas: API-first enforcement, API to configure quotas, optional admin console in follow-up." Suggested tags: customer-request, canonicalization, priority:P2, stakeholder:ACME. Owner: @eva (PM) unless objections.

triage-bot: Duplicate detection matched threads 2042, 2098, 2101 -> created candidate canonical intake draft. Confidence: 0.87.

sam: Created a canonical intake record: /intake create --title "Per-tenant rate limits" --refs 2042,2098,2101 --priority P2 --owner @eva --tags customer-request,backend,quota. Intake ID: intake-1795123002-1.

kevin: Rough estimate for MVP (API enforcement + config endpoint + e2e tests): ~3 dev sprints + 1 QA sprint. Console/dashboard is separate +1-2 sprints. For MVP we should scope down to API + simple telemetry.

eva: Agree to API-first MVP. Acceptance criteria to include: 1) ability to set per-tenant token quotas via API, 2) enforcement on all public endpoints, 3) telemetry emitted to console/observability. We should list specific endpoints and auth surface.

maria: I'll confirm ACME's minimal acceptance criteria today. They mentioned needing per-tenant throughput limits and a basic usage view, but said API-only is OK for initial rollout.

sam: I've updated each original customer thread with a short note and link to the canonical intake: "Thanks — we've consolidated similar requests into a single intake (intake-1795123002-1). PM @eva will follow up with scope and timeline."

eva: Nice. One operational note: if ACME signs an SLA or pays for priority support, we auto-escalate to priority:P1 and reassign to dedicated roadmap lane. @maria please flag if that happens. :thumbsup:

kevin: Also need a short checklist for engineering handoff: A) list of affected endpoints and current auth scheme, B) expected default quotas, C) metrics + tracing hooks. @sam can you paste the endpoint list?

sam: Endpoint list pasted: /v1/generate, /v1/embeddings, /v1/chat. Auth: tenant-id header + api-key. I'll add to the intake doc.

eva: I'll draft the update email to each customer with timeline, ask for confirmation on acceptance tests, and invite ACME to a quick sync if they want faster turnaround. Target: EOD.

intake-bot: intake-1795123002-1 updated: tags=[customer-request, backend, canonical], status=triaged, owner=@eva.

maria: Confirmed ACME is fine with API-first for initial phase but will request dashboard later. I'll loop them in after your draft @eva.

eva: Perfect. Closing action items: @maria confirm ACME SLA status; @kevin attach dev estimate to intake; @sam link endpoint & threads in intake; I'll send customer update. We'll reconvene if ACME wants to pay for priority.

kevin: ACK.

sam: ACK.

maria: ACK.
